Name: Cowgirls Maru and Emily
Author: YukoValis
Description:
The next step towards your own pet-play farm.  A harness, tight cow-suit , and probably some mystery potion later gets you two new cowgirls to add to the stables.  Well how else would you explain the body alteration?  Strange potions, lot's of exercise, whatever.. they are proud cows.

As my second major project it took about 12 hours.  I'm currently working on the next one which should be the dog and cat girls.  So I will keep going strong.  This will be the central piece mod, as it will be the only place I put the audio.  I don't want to put multiple copies of the HUGE audio file.
Please let me know if the audio sucks..  it was really difficult to make and figure out how to get it working.

NOTE: Nothing has changed with this sprite since 1.3, so it should still work.
